ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there is a positively charged H2O–H (hydrated hydrogen/protonated water) fragment, and there are curved arrows; on the right side is the main transition-state organic structure, containing H2N, R, two connected central carbons, OH, R1, and a CO2R2 ester group. The problem asks to ignore the arrows and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: Count only non-hydrogen bonds according to the specified method. The O–H bonds in the hydrated hydrogen fragment all involve hydrogen, so they are not counted. The countable non-hydrogen bonds in the main structure are: 1 N–C, 1 C–R, 1 C–C between the two central carbons, 1 C–O (the C–O in OH, O–H not counted), 1 C–R1, 1 C–CO2R2, 1 carbonyl C=O, 1 carbonyl C–O, 1 O–R2. The total is 9 non-hydrogen bonds.

method.method_draft: Scan the image and count only non-hydrogen bonds. Exclude the hydronium O-H bonds because they involve hydrogen. In the main structure count: N-C, C-R, C-C between the two central carbons, C-OH, C-R1, C-CO2R2, carbonyl C=O, carbonyl C-O, and O-R2. This gives 9 total bonds.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧有一个带正电的 H2O–H（水合氢/质子化水）片段，并有弯箭头；右侧是主要的过渡态有机结构，包含 H2N、R、两个相连的中心碳、OH、R1，以及 CO2R2 酯基。题目要求忽略箭头，并排除所有涉及氢的键。

推理：按指定方法只数非氢键。水合氢片段中的 O–H 键都涉及氢，因此不计。主要结构中可数的非氢键为：1 个 N–C，1 个 C–R，1 个两个中心碳之间的 C–C，1 个 C–O（OH 中的 C–O，O–H 不计），1 个 C–R1，1 个 C–CO2R2，1 个羰基 C=O，1 个羰基 C–O，1 个 O–R2。合计 9 个非氢键。

method.method_draft: Assign heavy-atom degrees from the image: N=1; R=1; the left central carbon=3; the right central carbon=4; OH oxygen=1; R1=1; carbonyl carbon=3; carbonyl oxygen=1; alkoxy oxygen=2; R2=1. The hydronium component contributes 0 heavy-atom degree because all its bonds are to H. Sum the degrees: 1+1+3+4+1+1+3+1+2+1=18, then divide by 2 to avoid double-counting each edge, giving 9 bonds.
